page.overview:
Who is Stiles?

Captain Stiles was a 22nd century United Earth Space Service officer who, along with other members of the Stiles family, was killed in service during the Earth-Romulan War.

A 23rd century descendant of Captain Stiles, Lieutenant , a navigator aboard the bitterly recalled the events of his family history during the Neutral Zone Incursion of 2266. ()
